items.caption: A modern drawing of 半 in the Shuowen Lesser Seal tradition, with 八 above 牛. It represents a received seal-script form, not an ancient artifact.
items.alt: Black seal-script strokes arranged as 八 above 牛, forming 半.
items.selection_reason: The attached drawing visibly shows 八 above 牛, and reference records identify a Small Seal form of 半. It illustrates a form tradition discussed in the entry; the image alone does not establish the parts’ historical interpretation.

limitations.text: The attachment shows a modern seal-style drawing. Its appearance does not establish an ancient date or prove the proposed reading of 八 as division and 牛 as the ox being divided.
